ABOUT

From full-stack web to AI agents

I am a Software Engineering graduate from Hazara University, Mansehra, and currently an AI Intern at BeeTechnica, Abbottabad, under the KP IT Board internship programme.

My work is AI agents in Python. An agent is not just a chatbot — it combines an LLM, tools, memory and a loop: it understands a question, calls real APIs to get live data, remembers context, checks its own answer, and replies in simple words. My first agent, Mausam Agent, is complete — weather, air quality, forecast and day planning, with proper error handling and logging.

Right now I am building SafarMate, a travel web app for the Hazara region, where I am adding AI features on top of a Next.js and FastAPI product. My background in full-stack web development helps me here — I can build the complete product around the AI, not just the model call.

My goal is simple: become a Junior AI Engineer who can build agents that solve real problems for real people.

AI AGENT · PYTHON

Mausam Agent

A weather and day-planning AI agent. Ask it about any city or valley in simple words — it fetches live data, thinks over it, and answers like a helpful local guide.

  • File memory — remembers your last place, so “mera sheher” works
  • Built properly — input validation, try/except error handling and logging throughout
